baruch.definition:
n. economic advisor to United States Presidents (1870-1965)
n. a disciple of and secretary for the prophet Jeremiah
n. an Apocryphal book ascribed to Baruch
baruch.translation: n. n. 巴鲁克（男子名）；（圣经）巴鲁书

baruch de spinoza.translation: [网络] 斯宾诺莎；巴鲁赫·德·斯宾诺莎；斯宾诺沙

baruch's sign.translation: [医] 巴鲁克氏征(见于伤寒)

barus effect.translation: [化] 巴勒斯效应; 溶体膨胀效应

baruti.translation: n. (Baruti)人名；(意、刚(金)、坦桑)巴鲁蒂
